linework.observation: Bold clean outlines define the headset, microphone cord, envelope and steel shelf.

colour.observation: Muted olive, charcoal, cream and warm gray.

shading.observation: Soft illustrated shadows and simplified equipment surfaces.

backgrounds.observation: Steel shelf and locker background are restrained and enclosed.

finish.observation: Clean object rendering with no obvious glitches.

content.observation: FAIL: frame contains both a communication headset and a separate sealed envelope; object scenes require one object only.

composition.observation: Two objects share the foreground and divide attention.

regions.foreground_props: Headset with attached microphone and a separate envelope.
regions.lighting: Warm directional highlight with soft shadows.

correction: Show one single sealed envelope centered alone on a steel shelf as the evidence of distance from home. Remove the headset and all other foreground objects. Preserve the clean outlined 2D style, muted palette and soft cel shadow.
